=={{Icons|Overview}} Overview==
The '''Sunken Sword''' is a melee [[Weapons|weapon]] found through [[fishing]] and underwater [[Chests|chests]], and is one of the four items in the [[Sunken Iron Set]]. Dealing at least 5% damage of a target's total maximum HP with the Sunken Sword will apply the {{StatusEffectsText|Soaked}} status effect, whether through an M1, Rising Tide or regular bladed weapon skills.

It is one of the eight sunken items, the others being the other three pieces of the [[Sunken Iron Set]], and four pieces of the [[Sunken Warrior Set]] ''(including the [[Sunken Staff]])''. As such it has a base 1 in 16,000 ''(0.00625%)'' chance of being obtained while fishing.

There's a helpful "pity counter": after 3,000 fish, the 3,001st catch guarantees a sunken item. This counter doesn't reset if you find one earlier or miss the sunken catch.

Sunken items can be found from any underwater [[Chests|Chest]] or [[Lost Cargo]] with a 1 in 3,000 chance or 1 in 1,500 for abyssal depths ''(affected by luck potions, but not by fishing sunken pity)''. Specifically getting a Sunken Sword from an Underwater chest is a 1 in 24,000 chance ''(0.0041<u>6</u>%)''

[https://discord.com/channels/160982950710738945/1044624831125143663/1143706956972949584 Vetex has confirmed] that the item chance does affect the chance of getting sunken items in the patreon exclusive channel of the game's discord server.

'''A word of warning: People attempt to sell this without its unique skill <u>Rising Tide</u>. Please be wary, and read the moves on the weapon before purchasing it in trades or the Marketplace.'''

=={{Icons|Trivia}} Trivia == 
*The Sunken Sword's ability, Rising Tide, was initially called Tidal Drive before being renamed in update v1.0.23. 
**As of update 1.2.52, Sunken Sword's Rising Tide cooldown was extended to 8 seconds, and its casting time was set to 0.5 seconds.
*Two days after the release of the Fishing Update, the rate for catching sunken items was briefly halved to 1 in 4,000 in the v1.1.2 patch. This was reverted the following day in the v1.1.4 patch.
*The full set may be a successor to Arcane Adventure's [[Sunken Warrior Set|Sunken Warrior]]/Champion Set.
*The Sunken Sword is a retextured [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/880499904/The-Blade-of-the-Federation Blade of the Federation]
*The Bronze's Rod with Ensnaring enchant is recommended to get this item. 
**[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLEz1Hd4oZQ A video] comparing the Bronze Rod and the Collector's Rod for fishing Sunken gear.
*Vetex calls the Sunken Sword "the best weapon in game" due to it being not only close range combat item, but also a mobility item. ''(This was before World of Magic was scrapped and turned into Arcane Odyssey)''
*When imbuing the Sunken Sword with a heat-based magic, the imbue will be changed to the scalding status effect, which will also change the skill name to "Searing". 
**The imbuement does not have an icon yet, and the stat changes and syergies are identical to that of [[Fire Magic]].
**With specifically plasma magic, the magic circle which appears when imbuing will always be a gamma plasma circle, even if you have nova plasma. This is likely due to plasma being the only heat magic with a variant, so Vetex didn't bother to code it for the one instance. This however allows you to spam imbuement by pressing '''H''' and selecting your magic again causing the circle to reappear, and the imbuement animation to play this used to cause a memory leak but it was patched.

=={{Icons|Overview}} Overview==
The '''Colossal Greatsword''' is an Rare greatsword that is dropped by [[Evander]]. For it's heavy weight and large size, Evander wears a steel arm gauntlet of similar weight to counterweight the heaviness of this greatsword.

Much like the [[Lion's Halberd]] and [[Lance of Loyalty]], it's of the [[Weapons|Strength Weapon]] family and therefore can only be used by builds that invest in both the Strength and Weapon stat, this means that the Colossal Greatsword along with its 'siblings' are locked to [[Warlord]] [[Stat Builds]] and [[Savant]] [[Stat Builds]], to be used entirely aside from normal Swing attacks.

Much like the other [[Weapons|Strength Weapons]], its weapon skills' requirements are split in two (for strength and weapon respectively), which makes it relatively easy to build a skill list.

=={{Icons|Heading}} Weapon skills==
==='''Applied effect: Poisoned.'''===
This weapon's attacks inflict the {{StatusEffectsText|Poisoned}} status effect, dealing 4% of the attack's damage per second for 20 seconds, for up to 80% additional damage in total. The effect's visuals are identical to Poison Magic's toxin variant and it shares the same synergies and reactions as Poison itself. Just like with Poison Magic, the status effect's duration can be refreshed, and its duration will update if the enemy is hit with Poison Magic, Poison Imbued weapons or a Poison Tooth Dagger attack, the DoT's damage will increase if the refreshing attack deals more damage than the one before.

=={{Icons|Overview}} Overview==
Commodore Kai's Sabre is a [[Weapons|unique weapon]] that can be dropped by [[Commodore Kai|Commodore Kai, The Red Sabre]]. Kai is a mini-boss found in [[Silverhold]], specifically in the upstairs section above the reception area. When defeated, he has a 1/10 chance to drop Kai's Sabre. It's a long bladed weapon, but it appears to be a sabre by its design. This weapon is very useful for most weapon builds, as it boasts good quality, speed, and size while having reasonable stat requirements.  

Having a weapon-based build and charging energy will unleash a red aura while holding Kai's Sabre. [[Warrior|Warriors]] (Including [[Commodore Kai]]) will have a red aura when attacking with the sabre.

description: Overview thumb|202x202px|Cursebane, General Argos' devourer weapon Disclaimer: Devourers currently only serve narrative purposes and cannot be used by players, similar to Sea Curse
wikiText:
== {{Icons|Overview}} Overview==
[[File:Cursebane.jpeg|thumb|202x202px|Cursebane, General Argos' devourer weapon]] 
''<u>'''Disclaimer:'''</u> Devourers currently only serve narrative purposes and '''cannot be used by players''', similar to [[Sea Curses]].''

A '''Devourer''' is a class of [[weapons]] made with extremely potent [[arcanium]] that has the ability to take a ''[[Sea Curses|sea curse]]'' already merged with its owner, returning it to its native cube form. When the Devourer is removed from the victim, the sea curse will materialize as a cube at that location, bursting violently out of the blade, shattering the weapon completely and rendering it unusable. Unless a devourer is used, a curse user's sea curse will blast to a faraway location, making devourers an effective option for extracting and collecting sea curses. 

While embedded in someone, a devourer will drain their magic energy similar to the handcuffs the [[Grand Navy]] use to incarcerate mages but to a greater extent, usually resulting in the curse user's death unless sustained through some other means. (E.x [[Brewing|Potions]])
__TOC__
== {{Icons|Heading}} Usage==
On a mission to find the informant who knows of the [[Sea Curses|Death Curse]]'s location, General Argos uses a devourer (not "Cursebane"<ref name="VetexConf">[[:File:Vetex on December 24th 2023 about Cursebane.png|Confirmed by vetex]]</ref>) to incapacitate [[Beringer]] on the Sky Islands, Beringer is an emissary of the [[Azura Province]] and was previously the Cloud Curse user. Argos then left the devourer impaling Beringer until they took him to Fort Talos, removing the weapon once they had imprisoned him, extracting the [[Sea Curses|Cloud Curse]] for the [[Order of Aesir]].

=={{Icons|Trivia}} Trivia==

*"Cursebane" is the stated name for one of [[General Argos]]' devourers, it is currently inside [[Ravenna Castello]]<ref name="VetexConf"/>.
*The process of creating a Devourer class weapon is explained through a book found at the secret location of [[Port Mistral]], alongside the process to create [[Arcanium]] equipment.
*It is implied that Devourers can pull in nearby Magical energy, as per General Argos's Third Phase move "Baron's Judgment."
